headline: Four o'clock keeps its own counsel.
body: The city has thinned to pipes and distant tyres. A kettle in some other kitchen clicks off and the quiet rearranges itself. Paper on the desk has taken the lamp's colour and will not give it back.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: pre-dawn slate, no stars worth naming

pulses.label: Mood
pulses.value: the last honest hour before the clocks insist

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: desk lamp only; windows still black
